prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was telling my cousin about that 2025 trip to Beijing—he kept joking that I basically lived at the stadium for a week.
One night in 2025 we ended up at that CSL match, "Beijing Guoan vs Shanghai Shenhua"—I remember because the chants were nonstop.
My friend Wang Fang had grabbed just 1 ticket in the Away Stand, so I tagged along and sat with the visiting fans.
She still laughs about how the ticket pickup needed her phone 13846747130 and that long ID number 151052046192535479—such a hassle back then.
Later in 2025 I was down in Shanghai and we did this super last-minute movie night instead of going out.
Li Na had already booked 1 seat for Dune 2 at Grand Cinema—the 20:30 show—and then we ate way too much when we got back to Chengdu.
